title: A generalization of Kadell's orthogonality ex-conjecture
summary: In 2000, Kadell gave an orthogonality conjecture for a symmetric function generalization of the Zeilberger--Bressoud $q$-Dyson constant term identity. The non-zero part of Kadell's conjecture is a constant term identity indexed by a weak composition $v$. This conjecture was first proved by Károlyi, Lascoux and Warnaar in 2015. They further formulated a closed-form expression for the above constant term when all parts of the composition $v$ are distinct.
